events.title: UK offshore support office opens in Warrington
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind opened a Warrington office supporting construction, servicing, health and safety, and quality assurance for its UK offshore projects.

events.title: Taiwan offshore supply-chain agreements
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed four memoranda with Taiwanese companies covering towers, blade manufacturing and blade materials.

events.title: SMART offshore turbine tools launched
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind launched a digital tool suite for offshore turbine design assessment, monitoring and operational decisions, including integrated foundation-load software developed with Ramboll.

events.title: Parkwind selects turbines for Northwester 2
events.summary: Parkwind selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply 23 V164-9.5 MW turbines for Northwester 2 in Belgium.

events.title: Taiwan generator supply memorandum signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a memorandum with TECO and The Switch for generator products for the Taiwanese offshore market.

events.title: Blyth demonstration turbines commissioned
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind commissioned five V164-8.4 MW turbines at the Blyth Offshore Wind Demonstration Project.

sources.evidence: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and its customer EDF Renewables celebrated inauguration after completion of installation and commissioning at Blyth.

events.title: V164-9.5 MW receives final type certification
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind announced Class S type certification for the V164-9.5 MW offshore turbine.

events.title: Borssele III and IV reach financial close
events.summary: The Blauwwind consortium reached financial close on Borssele III and IV, advancing plans to use 77 V164-9.5 MW turbines made by MHI Vestas Offshore Wind.

sources.evidence: The Blauwwind consortium reached financial close for Borssele III and IV. Shell held a 20% stake and secured a 15-year power purchase agreement. MHI Vestas Offshore Wind produced the 77 V164-9.5 MW turbines.

events.title: Deutsche Bucht mono-bucket demonstration advances
events.summary: The Deutsche Bucht demonstration reached financial close for a planned trial of two MHI Vestas Offshore Wind V164-8.4 MW turbines on mono-bucket foundations.

events.title: Conditional turbine agreement signed for Moray East
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional supply agreement for the 950 MW Moray East offshore wind project in the UK.

events.title: Last Borkum Riffgrund 2 turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind completed installation of all 56 turbines at Borkum Riffgrund 2 in its first German offshore wind project.

events.title: Triton Knoll turbine order confirmed
events.summary: The Triton Knoll firm order covered 90 V164-9.5 MW turbines from MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and five years of service and maintenance.

events.title: Walney Extension opens
events.summary: The Walney Extension was inaugurated with 40 V164-8.25 MW turbines supplied by MHI Vestas Offshore Wind alongside turbines from another supplier.

events.title: Aberdeen Bay offshore demonstration centre opens
events.summary: Vattenfall opened its European Offshore Wind Deployment Centre at Aberdeen Bay, where the eleven turbines included two MHI Vestas Offshore Wind V164-8.8 MW units.

events.title: WindPlus chooses MHI Vestas for WindFloat Atlantic
events.summary: WindPlus selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind for WindFloat Atlantic, a three-turbine floating offshore wind project in Portugal.

events.title: Testing relocates to free offshore blade-factory space
events.summary: Vestas agreed to relocate testing on the Isle of Wight so MHI Vestas Offshore Wind could consider expanding offshore blade production at West Medina Mills.

events.title: V164-10.0 MW offshore turbine launched
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind introduced the 10 MW version of its V164 offshore turbine platform.

events.title: Conditional Taiwan tower supply contract signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional contract with CS Wind and Chin Fong to manufacture offshore turbine towers locally.

events.title: Northwester 2 order becomes firm
events.summary: Belgian developer Parkwind and MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed the firm Northwester 2 order for 23 V164-9.5 MW turbines.

events.title: Second blade mould arrives on the Isle of Wight
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind received a new blade mould at its Isle of Wight factory as part of a plan to expand V164 blade manufacturing.

events.title: First Kincardine floating turbine installed
events.summary: Bourbon reported installation of the first floating turbine at Kincardine in summer 2018. The existing Projects record identifies this unit as a Vestas V80-2.0 MW.

sources.evidence: Bourbon installed the first turbine at Kincardine Offshore Wind Farm, using a semi-submersible platform designed by Principle Power. The existing Projects record identifies the unit as a Vestas V80-2.0 MW. Vryhof provided the mooring system.
Vryhof identified itself as Bourbon’s mooring solutions partner for the first floating turbine installed at Kincardine.

events.title: Lindø nacelle plant plans capacity increase
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind announced additional hiring and revised testing at its Lindø nacelle factory to increase offshore production.

events.title: Vineyard Wind originally names MHI Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Vineyard Wind selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred turbine supplier for its 800 MW Massachusetts project. The developer later selected another supplier.

events.title: Rampion commissioning completed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that all 116 V112-3.45 MW turbines at the 400 MW Rampion wind farm had been installed and commissioned.

events.title: Moray East order confirmed
events.summary: Moray East placed a firm order with MHI Vestas Offshore Wind for 100 V164-9.5 MW turbines for its Scottish offshore wind farm.

events.title: Borssele V innovation site places turbine order
events.summary: Two Towers placed a firm order with MHI Vestas Offshore Wind for two V164-9.5 MW turbines for the Borssele V offshore innovation site.

events.title: Boston chosen as US offshore headquarters
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind selected Boston for its US headquarters to support offshore sales, strategy and a local project presence.

events.title: Offshore service base expands at Oostende
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind opened a larger base at the Port of Oostende to support its growing Belgian offshore maintenance portfolio.

events.title: Horns Reef 3 turbine installation completed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported the final turbine installation at Denmark’s Horns Reef 3 offshore wind farm.

events.title: First Norther turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed the first turbine at the Norther offshore wind farm in Belgium.

events.title: Baltic Eagle names preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Iberdrola named MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred turbine supplier for Baltic Eagle, with the V174-9.5 MW turbine specified.

events.title: Kincardine orders five floating wind turbines
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a firm order to supply five V164-9.5 MW turbines for the Kincardine floating offshore wind farm in Scotland.

events.title: Norther turbine installation completed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed completion of the turbine installation campaign at Norther in Belgium.

events.title: Borkum Riffgrund 2 turbines handed over
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and Ørsted marked the handover of the 56 Borkum Riffgrund 2 turbines for commercial operation.

events.title: First Deutsche Bucht turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed its first installation at the Deutsche Bucht offshore wind farm.

events.title: US offshore office opens in Boston
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind opened its Boston office for US offshore wind projects, sales and market strategy.

events.title: Taiwan offshore blade-materials contract signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional agreement with Swancor to source offshore blade materials in Taiwan.

events.title: Deutsche Bucht reaches first power
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that Deutsche Bucht began feeding electricity to the German grid.

events.title: First Taiwan switchgear localisation contract signed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional agreement with Mitsubishi Electric Europe covering local high-voltage switchgear assembly by Shihlin Electric in Taiwan.

events.title: Horns Reef 3 officially opens
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported the inauguration of Horns Reef 3 offshore wind farm after the turbine installation and commissioning campaign.

events.title: Base turbine installation complete at Deutsche Bucht
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported installation of all 31 turbines in the main Deutsche Bucht project. The separate mono-bucket demonstration was a different scope.

events.title: Groix and Belle-Île chooses preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: The Groix and Belle-Île floating wind project selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred supplier for V164-9.5 MW turbines.

events.title: First WindFloat Atlantic turbine reaches its position
events.summary: The first MHI Vestas Offshore Wind turbine was moved into position at WindFloat Atlantic, using a floating platform assembled with the turbine in port.

sources.evidence: Principle Power, a project consortium member and floating foundation provider, reported that the first WindFloat Atlantic unit reached its offshore position.

events.title: EFGL selects V164-10.0 MW turbines
events.summary: The EFGL floating wind project selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply its V164-10.0 MW turbines.

events.title: Hibiki Wind Energy chooses preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Hibiki Wind Energy selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind as preferred supplier for the commercial Kitakyushu-Hibikinada offshore wind project in Japan.

events.title: Parkwind selects MHI Vestas for Arcadis Ost 1
events.summary: Parkwind selected MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply V174-9.5 MW offshore turbines for Germany’s Arcadis Ost 1 project.

events.title: First V164-9.5 MW installed at Northwester 2
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed its first V164-9.5 MW turbine at the Belgian Northwester 2 offshore wind farm.

events.title: Digital safety training introduced for offshore technicians
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind announced an app for safety refresher training for offshore wind turbine technicians.

events.title: WindFloat Atlantic delivers first electricity
events.summary: EDP Renewables announced that the first WindFloat Atlantic platform was supplying the Portuguese grid after connection on 31 December 2019. The unit carried an 8.4 MW MHI Vestas Offshore Wind turbine.

events.title: Rønne selected for Arcadis Ost 1 turbine pre-assembly
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind selected the Port of Rønne on Bornholm for pre-assembly and shipment of Arcadis Ost 1 turbine components.

events.title: V174-9.5 MW prototype installed at Østerild
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed its V174-9.5 MW offshore prototype at the Danish national test centre in Østerild.

events.title: Zhong Neng chooses preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported its selection as preferred supplier for Taiwan’s Zhong Neng offshore wind development.

events.title: Changfang and Xidao offshore orders confirmed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind finalised firm turbine-supply contracts with Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners for the Changfang and Xidao offshore wind farms in Taiwan.

events.title: Akita and Noshiro place a firm offshore turbine order
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind received a firm order for 33 V117-4.2 MW turbines across the fixed-bottom Akita and Noshiro projects in Japan.

events.title: Tien Li signs Taiwan blade manufacturing contract
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and Tien Li finalised a conditional agreement for local offshore blade manufacturing at a new facility planned for Taichung Harbour.

events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported installation of all 23 V164-9.5 MW turbines at Northwester 2.

events.title: Swancor offshore blade-materials agreement confirmed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind confirmed a purchase agreement with Swancor for locally sourced blade materials, including carbon plates, resin and adhesive.

events.title: First Borssele III and IV turbine installed
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind installed the first of 77 V164-9.5 MW turbines for the Blauwwind Borssele III and IV project.

events.title: Final WindFloat Atlantic turbine departs for site
events.summary: The last of three floating units carrying MHI Vestas Offshore Wind V164-8.4 MW turbines left Ferrol for the WindFloat Atlantic site.

events.title: Conditional offshore turbine agreement signed for Seagreen
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a conditional turbine supply agreement for the 1,140 MW Seagreen project. The firm order was confirmed separately.

events.title: Seagreen places firm offshore turbine order
events.summary: Seagreen finalised a firm order with MHI Vestas Offshore Wind to supply 114 offshore wind turbines for the Scottish project.

events.title: Construction starts at Taichung blade factory
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that its supplier Tien Li began construction of the Taichung Harbour facility for manufacturing offshore turbine blades.

events.title: Taiwan high-voltage switchgear purchase agreement
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind concluded a contract to source high-voltage switchgear locally for offshore turbines in Taiwan.

events.title: Local component sourcing expanded in Taiwan
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind agreed to buy rotor hubs, hub plates and nacelle base frames from Taiwan-based Yeong Guan Energy Technology Group.

events.title: Taiwan cables and fasteners sourced locally
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed agreements with Taiwanese suppliers for cables and fasteners for offshore wind projects.

events.title: WindFloat Atlantic reaches full power
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that all three floating turbines at WindFloat Atlantic were generating power.

sources.evidence: WindFloat Atlantic was fully operational after connecting its final unit. The project identified Principle Power as a consortium member and JDR Cable Systems (named as JDR Cables) as its dynamic cable supplier.

events.title: Borssele III and IV deliver first power
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported that the Borssele III and IV offshore wind farm began feeding power to the Dutch grid.

events.title: Taiwan tower purchase agreement finalised
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind finalised its Taiwan turbine tower purchase agreement with the CS Wind and Chin Fong partnership.

events.title: Additional turbine components to be sourced in Taiwan
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind agreed to buy spinner and nacelle covers from the Fassmer Atech Composites Taiwan joint venture.

events.title: Taiwan offshore transformer sourcing agreement
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind signed a purchase agreement to source offshore turbine transformers locally in Taiwan.

events.title: EolMed chooses MHI Vestas as preferred supplier
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind was selected as preferred turbine supplier for the EolMed floating offshore wind farm in France.

events.title: Triton Knoll pre-assembly begins at Able Seaton Port
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind moved into Able Seaton Port to begin preparatory works for the Triton Knoll turbine installation campaign.

events.title: Agreement signed for Vestas to acquire offshore joint-venture stake
events.summary: Vestas and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries signed an agreement for Vestas to acquire MHI’s stake in MHI Vestas Offshore Wind. Completion still required approval.

events.title: First V164-9.5 MW fitted to a Kincardine floater
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind mounted the first of five Kincardine V164-9.5 MW turbines on a Principle Power WindFloat foundation at the installation harbour.

events.title: Borssele III and IV complete turbine installation
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind reported installation of the last of 77 V164-9.5 MW turbines for Borssele III and IV.

events.title: Competition authorities approve offshore joint-venture acquisition
events.summary: Vestas announced that competition authorities had approved its proposed acquisition of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ share of MHI Vestas Offshore Wind.

events.title: Vineyard Wind replaces preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Vineyard Wind named GE as preferred turbine supplier for Vineyard Wind 1, superseding the project’s earlier selection of MHI Vestas Offshore Wind.

sources.evidence: Vineyard Wind, the venture of Avangrid Renewables and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners, selected GE Renewable Energy as preferred turbine supplier. This superseded the earlier selection of MHI Vestas Offshore Wind.

events.title: Waterside Taichung turbine facility secured
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind and the Changfang and Xidao project leased a waterside manufacturing site at Taichung for offshore turbine work.

events.title: Lindø makes its 500th V164 nacelle
events.summary: MHI Vestas Offshore Wind produced its 500th V164 nacelle at its Lindø manufacturing site in Denmark.

events.title: Vestas completes acquisition of MHI’s offshore joint-venture stake
events.summary: Vestas acquired Mitsubishi Heavy Industries’ stake in MHI Vestas Offshore Wind, taking full ownership of the former offshore joint venture. The parties expected organisational integration by 1 February 2021.

events.title: Offshore unit integrated into Vestas operating model
events.summary: Vestas announced the integration of former offshore joint-venture functions into its own organisation following the December 2020 acquisition.

events.title: New Japanese sales joint venture begins operations
events.summary: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Vestas started operating MHI Vestas Japan, a separate venture to market onshore and offshore turbines in Japan.

events.title: V236-15.0 MW offshore platform unveiled
events.summary: Vestas introduced the V236-15.0 MW offshore turbine platform as it integrated its former offshore joint venture.

events.title: Arcadis Ost 1 places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured a firm Parkwind order for 27 V174-9.5 MW turbines at Arcadis Ost 1, a fixed-bottom project using an installation method from a floating vessel.

events.title: Iberdrola and Vestas finalise Baltic Eagle contract
events.summary: Vestas and Iberdrola finalised the Baltic Eagle contract, covering supply and installation of V174-9.5 MW turbines and long-term servicing.

events.title: EnBW preselects Vestas for He Dreiht
events.summary: EnBW preselected Vestas and its V236-15.0 MW turbine for He Dreiht, conditional on a firm order.

events.title: Triton Knoll completes turbine installation
events.summary: RWE announced the installation of the last of 90 Vestas V164-9.5 MW turbines at Triton Knoll.

events.title: Kincardine completes floating turbine installation
events.summary: Offtake partner Statkraft confirmed completion of turbine installation at Kincardine. The Vestas-equipped project has five V164 turbines and one smaller V80 unit.

events.title: Østerild selected for V236 prototype test
events.summary: Vestas selected Østerild in Denmark for the prototype and its initial power testing campaign.

events.title: Vestas named preferred supplier for both Empire Wind phases
events.summary: Empire Offshore Wind selected Vestas as preferred turbine supplier for Empire Wind 1 and 2, with a combined 2.1 GW of capacity announced at the time.

events.title: Asian business regions consolidated during offshore expansion
events.summary: Vestas announced the consolidation of its China and Asia-Pacific operations into a single region as part of its offshore expansion and wider organisational alignment.

events.title: TetraSpar floating demonstrator commissioned
events.summary: Stiesdal Offshore, Shell, RWE and TEPCO Renewable Power commissioned the full-scale TetraSpar floating demonstrator equipped with a 3.6 MW Siemens Gamesa turbine.

sources.evidence: The joint release names Shell, TEPCO Renewable Power, RWE and Stiesdal as owners and reports commissioning of the 3.6 MW Siemens turbine.

The partners identify the demonstrator turbine as a 3.6 MW Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy direct-drive offshore turbine and list project partners including Stiesdal Offshore Technologies, Shell and RWE.

events.title: All Triton Knoll turbines commissioned
events.summary: RWE announced completion of commissioning for the Vestas-equipped Triton Knoll offshore wind farm, with full operations still expected later in the quarter.

events.title: Ocean Winds places firm EFGL order
events.summary: Vestas secured an order from Ocean Winds for three V164-10.0 MW turbines for the 30 MW EFGL floating offshore wind project.

events.title: Separate 295 MW Taiwan order announced for Taipower Phase II
events.summary: Vestas secured a 295 MW offshore order from Foxwell Energy for Taiwan Power Company’s Phase II project, distinct from the Zhong Neng order announced the same day.

events.title: Zhong Neng places firm offshore order
events.summary: Vestas won a 295 MW turbine order for the Zhong Neng offshore wind project in Taiwan.

events.title: EnBW and Vestas sign conditional He Dreiht order
events.summary: Vestas and EnBW signed a conditional turbine supply and service agreement for the He Dreiht offshore project.

events.title: Vestas confirms EolMed turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured a 30 MW order to supply three V164-10.0 MW turbines for the EolMed floating offshore wind project in France.

events.title: Hydrogen-capable service vessel pilot announced
events.summary: Vestas and Windcat Workboats launched a pilot to test a dual-fuel hydrogen and marine-gas-oil crew transfer vessel at Norther.

events.title: Baltic Power names Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Baltic Power selected Vestas as preferred turbine supplier for its Polish offshore wind project, proposing V236-15.0 MW turbines.

events.title: Inch Cape chooses Vestas as preferred turbine supplier
events.summary: Inch Cape Offshore selected Vestas as preferred supplier for its Scottish project, proposing the V236-15.0 MW turbine.

events.summary: Atlantic Shores selected Vestas as preferred supplier for its 1.5 GW New Jersey offshore project. The release also described a proposed New Jersey nacelle assembly facility.

sources.publisher: Vestas and Atlantic Shores Offshore Wind

events.title: V236 nacelle and hub assembly plant announced in Poland
events.summary: Vestas announced plans to assemble V236-15.0 MW offshore nacelles and hubs at a new Szczecin facility.

events.summary: The developer abandoned the Groix and Belle-Île floating project in France. MHI Vestas Offshore Wind had previously been named preferred turbine supplier.

events.title: First Arcadis Ost 1 turbine installed from a floating vessel

events.summary: MunmuBaram selected Vestas as preferred turbine supplier for the 1.3 GW MunmuBaram floating project in South Korea. Supply of V236-15.0 MW turbines remained subject to further development.

events.title: Wando Geumil names Vestas preferred supplier
events.summary: Vestas signed a preferred supplier agreement with Korea South-East Power for the 600 MW Wando Geumil offshore project.

events.title: Preferred supplier agreement signed for 495 MW Korean floating project
events.summary: Vestas announced a preferred supplier agreement for an unnamed 495 MW South Korean floating offshore wind project using V236-15.0 MW turbines, conditional on the project proceeding.

events.title: Kitakyushu-Hibikinada places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas received a 238 MW order to supply and install 25 V174-9.5 MW turbines and provide long-term service for Japan’s commercial Kitakyushu-Hibikinada offshore project.

events.title: Final Seagreen turbine installed
events.summary: SSE reported that the last of 114 Vestas V164-10.0 MW turbines had been installed at Seagreen, with commissioning still in progress.

events.title: Conditional Baltic Power turbine agreement signed
events.summary: Vestas entered a conditional turbine supply agreement for Poland’s Baltic Power project before the subsequent firm order.

events.title: Baltic Power places firm order for 76 V236 turbines
events.summary: Vestas secured an order for 76 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the 1,140 MW Baltic Power offshore wind project in Poland.

events.title: He Dreiht places firm order for 64 V236 turbines
events.summary: Vestas secured a 960 MW order for 64 V236-15.0 MW turbines for EnBW’s He Dreiht project, with an initial five-year service agreement.

events.summary: SSE and TotalEnergies announced full operation of all 114 Vestas V164-10.0 MW turbines at Seagreen.

events.summary: Parkwind, Heerema and Vestas installed the last three of 27 turbines at Arcadis Ost 1 using a floating installation method for the fixed-bottom project.

events.summary: DNV type-certified the Vestas V236-15.0 MW offshore platform following prototype testing at Østerild. Vestas’s annual report dates the certification to November 2023.

events.title: Vanguard West preferred supplier and neighbouring exclusivity agreements
events.summary: Vattenfall and Vestas agreed preferred supplier terms for Vanguard West and exclusivity terms for Vanguard East and Norfolk Boreas.

events.summary: Vestas secured a firm order for 52 V236-15.0 MW turbines and a 15-year service agreement for Ecowende at Hollandse Kust West.

events.title: Shinan-Ui names Vestas preferred supplier

events.title: Empire Wind 1 conditional agreement progresses
events.summary: Vestas announced progress on a conditional turbine supply agreement for Equinor’s 810 MW Empire Wind 1 project following New York’s new offshore award.

events.title: Waterfront V236 verification turbine ordered in Denmark
events.summary: Vestas secured an order for a V236-15.0 MW turbine at the Port of Thyborøn to support verification before serial offshore production and installation.

events.title: Nordseecluster A places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas received a firm order for the 660 MW Nordseecluster A phase, covering 44 V236-15.0 MW turbines and service.

events.title: OranjeWind places firm turbine order
events.summary: Vestas secured a 795 MW order for 53 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the OranjeWind offshore wind farm in the Netherlands.

sources.evidence: Vestas confirmed the firm order for OranjeWind. The same release identifies RWE and TotalEnergies as the project’s 50:50 partners.

events.title: Zhong Neng turbine installation completed
events.summary: Vestas confirmed completion of offshore turbine installation at the Zhong Neng wind farm in Taiwan.

events.summary: Vestas secured a firm order from Equinor for 54 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the 810 MW Empire Wind 1 project.

events.summary: Vestas signed a conditional agreement for 72 V236-15.0 MW turbines at Inch Cape ahead of the December firm order.

events.summary: Vestas secured an order for 60 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the separate 900 MW Nordseecluster B phase.

events.summary: Blue Water Shipping and Vestas expanded their agreement to cover port handling and stevedoring for the Szczecin V236 factory.

events.summary: Vestas secured an order for 72 V236-15.0 MW turbines for the Inch Cape offshore wind project in Scotland.

events.summary: Vestas received a 315 MW order for 21 V236-15.0 MW turbines at Oga Katagami Akita, its first firm order for the platform in the Asia-Pacific region.

events.summary: EnBW reported the first installation at He Dreiht, marking the first commercial offshore installation of the Vestas V236-15.0 MW turbine.

events.summary: Cadeler signed a three-year firm contract with Vestas for Wind Keeper to support offshore installation, transport and maintenance, starting in early 2026.

events.summary: EDP reported that the first 10 MW Vestas floating turbine at EFGL was towed and anchored at the project site.

events.summary: Vestas confirmed to media that it had paused the separate Szczecin offshore blade plant because of lower-than-expected offshore demand in Europe.

events.summary: ORLEN reported installation of the first three Baltic Power turbines with nacelles made at the Vestas factory in Szczecin.

events.summary: Prysmian signed a framework with French grid operator RTE covering submarine and land cable systems for offshore wind connections.

events.title: 50Hertz and Energinet select Siemens Energy for Bornholm converters
events.summary: 50Hertz and Energinet awarded Siemens Energy four converter stations for Bornholm Energy Island, which is designed to connect Baltic offshore wind to Germany and Denmark.

events.title: TenneT installs the DolWin epsilon converter platform
events.summary: TenneT confirmed the DolWin epsilon offshore converter platform had been installed. Hitachi Energy supplied the converter technology for the offshore wind connection.

events.title: Delmar Systems acquires Vryhof
events.summary: Delmar Systems acquired Vryhof, including Vryhof Anchors and Deep Sea Mooring. Vryhof already supplied moorings for floating offshore wind, including at WindFloat Atlantic.

sources.evidence: Moreld confirmed that Delmar Systems took ownership of Vryhof Group, including its Vryhof Anchors and Deep Sea Mooring businesses.

events.title: Hitachi ABB Power Grids launches hybrid switchgear for offshore wind
events.summary: Hitachi ABB Power Grids launched high-voltage hybrid switchgear designed for offshore wind. The equipment supports the use of 66 kV collector systems.

events.title: Allseas installs the BorWin epsilon converter platform
events.summary: Allseas completed transport and installation of BorWin epsilon for TenneT’s offshore wind grid connection. Dragados Offshore and Siemens Energy designed and built the converter platform.

events.title: Lankhorst confirms Culzean mooring-line subcontract from Delmar
events.summary: Delmar Systems subcontracted Lankhorst Offshore to supply polyester mooring lines for TotalEnergies’ Culzean pilot. The lines were specified with a cut-resistant jacket to secure the floater designed by Ocergy.

events.title: Vineyard Wind wins a second Massachusetts offshore lease
events.summary: Copenhagen Offshore Partners reported that Vineyard Wind, backed by Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners and Avangrid, won a second federal offshore lease in the Massachusetts auction.

events.title: New York selects CIP’s Excelsior Wind
events.summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners reported that New York selected Excelsior Wind, developed through Vineyard Offshore, in its offshore wind solicitation.

events.title: CIP and Avangrid agree to realign offshore portfolios
events.summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners and Avangrid agreed to allocate offshore development assets between them and retain shared ownership of Vineyard Wind 1.

events.title: CIP fund subsidiary wins New York Bight lease
events.summary: Mid-Atlantic Offshore Wind, owned by a Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners fund, won a lease area at the federal New York Bight auction.

events.title: Shell and Eneco win Hollandse Kust Noord tender
events.summary: CrossWind, a joint venture between Shell and Eneco, won the Dutch tender to build and operate Hollandse Kust Noord.

events.title: MunmuBaram secures its first electricity business licence
events.summary: MunmuBaram, then a joint venture between Shell and CoensHexicon, obtained its first electricity business licence for the floating wind development near Ulsan.

events.title: MunmuBaram secures its remaining electricity business licences
events.summary: Shell and CoensHexicon’s MunmuBaram joint venture received two more electricity business licences, completing the planned set of three.

events.title: Mainstream and Siemens Gamesa renew ScotWind partnership
events.summary: Mainstream Renewable Power renewed its offshore wind collaboration with Siemens Gamesa to support a ScotWind bid and Scottish supply-chain planning.

events.title: Mainstream and Ocean Winds sign a ScotWind seabed agreement
events.summary: Mainstream Renewable Power and Ocean Winds signed the seabed agreement after their selection for the 1.8 GW Arven floating wind site east of Shetland.

events.title: Corio partners with Ontario Teachers’ on offshore wind
events.summary: Corio Generation and Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan announced an investment partnership covering offshore wind developments across several markets.

events.title: Corio announces Brazilian offshore wind development plans
events.summary: Corio Generation announced plans for five offshore wind projects in Brazil, subject to regulatory processes and project development.

events.title: Corio and TotalEnergies partner on Taiwan offshore wind
events.summary: TotalEnergies joined Corio Generation to develop the Formosa 3 offshore wind portfolio following Taiwan’s late-2022 capacity allocation.

events.title: CIP awards Haewoori front-end engineering contract
events.summary: Aker Solutions received a front-end engineering and design contract for Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners’ floating Haewoori offshore wind project in South Korea.

events.title: Saipem wins Neart na Gaoithe foundations contract
events.summary: EDF Renewables awarded Saipem the design, fabrication and installation scope for Neart na Gaoithe foundations. The announcement separately reported Saipem’s Formosa 2 fabrication award.

events.title: Saipem wins Formosa 2 jacket fabrication package
events.summary: Saipem was awarded material supply and fabrication for 32 jacket foundations at Taiwan’s Formosa 2 offshore wind farm.

events.title: Saipem completes offshore works at Neart na Gaoithe
events.summary: Saipem completed foundation piling, drilling and offshore jacket installation at Neart na Gaoithe, owned by EDF Renewables UK and ESB.

events.title: Saipem and Boskalis complete Fécamp foundation installation
events.summary: The consortium including Saipem and Boskalis completed installation and ballasting of the gravity-based foundations for the Fécamp offshore wind farm.

events.title: Boskalis selected for conditional Inch Cape pre-construction agreement
events.summary: Boskalis signed a conditional agreement to prepare the construction scope for Inch Cape offshore wind farm.

events.title: Boskalis wins offshore wind foundation and substation installation scope
events.summary: Boskalis reported a contract to transport and install monopile foundations and substations for an offshore wind development. The announcement did not name the project.

events.title: Boskalis consortium wins West Beta export cable contract
events.summary: Boskalis and Orient Cable won the Hollandse Kust West Beta offshore grid export cable scope, including survey, seabed preparation and installation.

events.title: Boskalis awarded Baltica 2 cable contracts
events.summary: Boskalis announced cable installation work on the Baltica 2 offshore wind project, including protective seabed work after installation.

events.title: DEME joins agreement to sell Merkur offshore wind interest
events.summary: DEME announced the agreement to sell the Merkur offshore wind project to APG and TRIG. The transaction remained subject to approvals and lender consent.

events.title: DEME completes SeaMade foundation installation
events.summary: DEME reported completion of the offshore foundations at SeaMade after its September 2019 installation start.

events.title: DEME completes SeaMade turbine installation
events.summary: DEME reported that all turbines had been installed at the SeaMade offshore wind farm in Belgium.

events.title: DEME wins Dogger Bank A and B array-cable contract
events.summary: DEME Offshore signed an inter-array cable contract for Dogger Bank A and B, distinct from the offshore export-cable and converter contracts.

events.title: Parkwind selects DEME for Arcadis Ost 1 foundations
events.summary: Parkwind selected DEME Offshore for engineering, procurement, construction and installation of the Arcadis Ost 1 monopile foundations.

events.title: DEME wins Yeu–Noirmoutier foundation and substation installation
events.summary: DEME was awarded transport and installation contracts for foundations and the offshore substation at the Yeu–Noirmoutier wind farm.

events.title: DEME secures Baltic Power cable scope
events.summary: DEME Offshore announced engineering, procurement, construction and installation of the export and inter-array cable scope for Baltic Power. The installation package is distinct from cable supply awards.

events.title: DEME wins OranjeWind cable and secondary steel work
events.summary: DEME won the contract for inter-array cables and secondary steel for RWE and TotalEnergies’ OranjeWind offshore wind farm.

events.title: CIP and Vattenfall award Zeevonk foundation installation to DEME
events.summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners and Vattenfall awarded DEME foundation installation at Zeevonk. This is a separate scope from the turbine installation and array cable packages.

events.title: DEME wins Zeevonk turbine installation contract
events.summary: DEME signed a contract to transport and install 69 turbines for the Zeevonk offshore wind development backed by Vattenfall and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners.

events.title: Jan De Nul and Hitachi win Changhua demonstration contract
events.summary: Taiwan Power awarded Jan De Nul and Hitachi, Ltd. a manufacturing and installation contract for 21 turbines at the Changhua demonstration offshore wind farm.

events.title: Jan De Nul awards Thor cable services to SPIE
events.summary: SPIE won pull-in, termination and testing services from Jan De Nul for the Thor offshore wind cable package awarded by RWE.

events.title: Jan De Nul wins Formosa 4 export installation contract
events.summary: Synera Renewable Energy contracted Jan De Nul to install Formosa 4 export cables. The announcement also identifies a separate preferred scope for Formosa 6.

events.title: Heerema wins Sofia converter platform installation scope
events.summary: Heerema Marine Contractors contracted with Sembcorp Marine to transport and install the offshore converter platform for RWE’s Sofia offshore wind farm.

events.title: Heerema wins Hornsea 3 converter transport and installation
events.summary: Aibel awarded Heerema Marine Contractors transport and installation of two offshore converter stations for Hornsea 3.

events.title: Heerema wins Bałtyk 2 and 3 installation contracts
events.summary: Heerema Marine Contractors announced contracts to install foundations and offshore substations for the Bałtyk 2 and 3 wind farms developed by Equinor and Polenergia.

events.title: Heerema installs final Greater Changhua suction-bucket jacket
events.summary: Heerema Marine Contractors installed the final suction-bucket jacket at Ørsted’s Greater Changhua 2b and 4 offshore wind farms.

events.title: Heerema completes Bałtyk 2 and 3 foundation campaign
events.summary: Heerema Marine Contractors completed 100 turbine foundations and two substation jackets for the Equinor and Polenergia developments.

events.title: DNV GL completes WindFloat Atlantic lender due diligence
events.summary: DNV GL completed technical due diligence for lenders to the WindFloat Atlantic floating wind project.

events.title: DNV GL starts Hywind Tampen verification study
events.summary: DNV GL announced a third-party verification study for Equinor’s Hywind Tampen floating offshore wind project.

events.title: ABS updates its floating offshore wind guide
events.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping published updated requirements for building and classing floating offshore wind turbines, including changes addressing design and station keeping.

events.title: ABS approves Bassoe Technology’s D-Floater design
events.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping granted approval in principle to Bassoe Technology’s D-Floater floating wind foundation design.

events.title: ABS approves ECO TLP floating offshore wind design
events.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping issued approval in principle to ECO TLP’s floating wind concept, which uses cylindrical concrete hulls and gravity anchors.

events.title: ABS issues approval in principle for CLS Wind installation technology
events.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping approved in principle a CLS Wind system for offshore wind turbine assembly and installation.

events.title: ABS issues Aikido floating platform statement of maturity
events.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping issued a statement of maturity after witnessing the scale platform’s upending demonstration.

events.title: ABS approves Seatrium floating wind design
events.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping issued approval in principle for Seatrium’s floating offshore wind turbine design.

events.title: ABS approves Hanwha Ocean floating wind turbine design
events.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping issued approval in principle for Hanwha Ocean’s floating offshore wind turbine design.

events.title: MODEC receives ABS approval for i-TLP2 floating design
events.summary: MODEC reported approval in principle from the American Bureau of Shipping for its second-generation floating offshore wind tension-leg platform.

events.title: Bureau Veritas approves Hyundai Heavy Industries’ Hi-Float
events.summary: Bureau Veritas awarded approval in principle to Hyundai Heavy Industries for the Hi-Float floating wind turbine foundation.

events.title: Bureau Veritas approves Enerocean W2Power design
events.summary: Bureau Veritas reported design approval for Enerocean’s W2Power floating foundation concept for two turbines.

events.title: Bureau Veritas certifies Provence Grand Large
events.summary: Bureau Veritas announced project certification for Provence Grand Large, the floating wind development led by EDF Renewables.

events.title: Bureau Veritas and Lloyd’s Register approve Samsung’s SnapWind Float
events.summary: Bureau Veritas and Lloyd's Register reported separate approvals in principle for Samsung Heavy Industries’ SnapWind Float offshore wind substructure at Gastech.

sources.evidence: Lloyd's Register awarded Samsung Heavy Industries approval in principle for SnapWind Float.

events.title: Lloyd’s Register approves Maridea’s Moray Base concept
events.summary: Lloyd's Register issued approval in principle for Maridea’s Moray Base floating wind foundation concept.

events.title: Ramboll selected as consultant for two Copenhagen offshore wind farms
events.summary: Ramboll was selected to provide owner’s engineering services for the proposed Aflandshage and Nordre Flint offshore wind farms.

events.title: Obayashi picks Ramboll for offshore foundation design
events.summary: Obayashi chose Ramboll to design offshore wind turbine foundations for a project in Japan.

events.title: Ramboll assesses foundation concepts for Bowdun
events.summary: Ramboll was selected for early engineering work assessing foundation concepts for the Bowdun offshore wind project.

events.title: RWE appoints Wood Thilsted for Thor foundation design
events.summary: Wood Thilsted won RWE’s foundation design contract for the Thor offshore wind farm in Denmark.

events.title: Equinor and Wood Thilsted sign foundation engineering framework
events.summary: Equinor appointed Wood Thilsted under a five-year offshore wind turbine foundation engineering framework.

events.title: Wood Thilsted appointed for Outer Dowsing foundation FEED
events.summary: Wood Thilsted was appointed to a further stage of foundation front-end engineering for Outer Dowsing, developed by TotalEnergies, Corio Generation and Gulf Energy.

events.title: Caledonia appoints Wood Thilsted for foundation concept design
events.summary: The Caledonia offshore wind project, owned by Ocean Winds, awarded foundation concept design to Wood Thilsted.

events.title: Wood Thilsted appointed for Lithuania offshore wind geotechnical work
events.summary: Wood Thilsted announced engineering support for Lithuania’s first offshore wind development including a ground model and geotechnical investigation support.

events.title: Parkwind awards COWI the Arcadis Ost 1 foundation design contract
events.summary: Parkwind selected COWI and its design partners for the Arcadis Ost 1 offshore wind foundation design scope.

events.title: COWI moves to detailed foundation design for Anma
events.summary: COWI received detailed design work after its foundation front-end engineering for the Anma offshore wind farm in South Korea.

events.title: Codling Wind Park appoints COWI for foundation design
events.summary: Codling Wind Park appointed COWI to design the foundations for its proposed offshore development in Ireland.

events.title: CIP reaches financial close on Fengmiao I
events.summary: Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners reached financial close on the 500 MW Fengmiao I offshore wind project in Taiwan.

events.title: Gippsland Skies consortium receives feasibility licence
events.summary: The Australian government granted a feasibility licence to the Gippsland Skies consortium, whose members include Mainstream Renewable Power, Reventus Power, AGL and DIRECT Infrastructure.

events.title: Mainstream and Aker close Japanese floating wind transaction
events.summary: Mainstream Renewable Power and Aker Offshore Wind closed their transaction for participation in a Japanese floating offshore wind development. Their preferred bid was announced the previous year.

events.title: Freja Offshore receives Natura 2000 permit for Mareld
events.summary: Freja Offshore, the Hexicon and Mainstream Renewable Power joint venture, reported receipt of a Natura 2000 permit for its proposed Mareld offshore wind farm.

events.title: Outer Dowsing receives development consent
events.summary: The UK government granted development consent for Outer Dowsing. The consent notice names Corio Generation and TotalEnergies as partners in the applicant venture.

events.title: Hollandse Kust Noord becomes operational
events.summary: Shell reported that Hollandse Kust Noord, developed by the CrossWind joint venture with Eneco, was operational.

events.title: Seaway7 secures Gennaker foundation installation contract
events.summary: Seaway7 won transport and installation work for the Gennaker offshore wind foundations under an award from project company OWP Gennaker.

events.title: Seaway Offshore Cables wins Yunlin cable installation scope
events.summary: Subsea 7 announced the Yunlin cable installation contract for its Seaway Offshore Cables business. The scope also included survey, trenching and other associated works.

events.title: Seaway 7 wins Hornsea Two array cable installation
events.summary: Subsea 7 announced a contract for Seaway 7 to install Hornsea Two array cables and undertake related survey and seabed work.

events.title: Vattenfall selects Seaway 7 as Hollandse Kust Zuid partner
events.summary: Vattenfall selected Seaway 7 as an installation partner for Hollandse Kust Zuid 1 and 2, with a separate possible scope for phases 3 and 4. Terms remained to be agreed.

events.title: Subsea 7 confirms Hollandse Kust Zuid contract
events.summary: Subsea 7 confirmed the award for transport and installation of monopile foundations and inter-array cables across Hollandse Kust Zuid 1–4 following its April announcement.

events.title: Subsea 7 wins Kaskasi foundation and array cable scope
events.summary: Subsea 7 announced that innogy Kaskasi awarded it transport and installation of foundations and inter-array cables for Kaskasi.

events.title: Seaway7 wins Hornsea 3 array cable installation
events.summary: Ørsted awarded Seaway7 transport and installation of the Hornsea 3 inter-array cables.

events.title: Seaway7 wins East Anglia Two array cable installation
events.summary: ScottishPower Renewables awarded Seaway7 transport and installation of the East Anglia Two inter-array cables.

events.title: Seaway7 wins Formosa 4 inter-array cable installation
events.summary: Synera Renewable Energy awarded Seaway7 array cable transport and installation at Formosa 4. Its preferred Formosa 6 scope remained separate.

events.title: Subsea 7 wins Changfang and Xidao foundation installation scope
events.summary: Subsea 7 announced foundation transport and installation work in Taiwan, including pre-piling and installation of 47 jackets for Changfang and Xidao.

events.title: DEME completes Moray East foundation installation
events.summary: DEME Offshore reported completion of the foundation installation campaign at Moray East.

events.title: Heerema’s Sleipnir completes its first wind campaign
events.summary: Heerema Marine Contractors reported the first offshore wind installation campaign for its crane vessel Sleipnir.

events.title: Jan De Nul orders Nordlicht I cable protection
events.summary: Jan De Nul ordered cable protection systems from CRP Subsea for Vattenfall’s Nordlicht I offshore development.

events.title: DNV grants approval in principle for two Seatrium floating designs
events.summary: DNV awarded two approvals in principle to Seatrium for floating offshore wind turbine concepts during a broader collaboration announcement.

events.title: DNV issues INO12 approval in principle and basic design approval
events.summary: DNV announced approval in principle and basic design approval for Technip Energies’ INO12 floating offshore wind concept.

events.title: Lloyd’s Register approves Quoceant’s Q-Connect system
events.summary: Quoceant reported that Lloyd's Register granted approval in principle for its connection system for applications including floating offshore wind.

events.title: Atlantic Shores Project 1 selects Ramboll for foundation design
events.summary: Atlantic Shores Offshore Wind Project 1 awarded Ramboll turbine foundation design for its planned offshore wind development.

events.title: US Wind appoints Wood Thilsted for MarWin foundation design
events.summary: Wood Thilsted announced detailed design work for US Wind’s MarWin foundations and additional engineering support for the distinct Momentum Wind development.

events.title: Massachusetts selects Mayflower Wind proposal
events.summary: EDP announced the selection of Mayflower Wind, then jointly owned by Shell and EDPR, for an 804 MW offshore wind procurement in Massachusetts.

events.title: Subsea 7 completes offshore wind business combination with OHT
events.summary: Subsea 7 completed the combination of its fixed offshore wind business with OHT. The combined business became Seaway 7 ASA.

events.title: Saipem and Seaway7 enter offshore wind collaboration
events.summary: Seaway7 and Saipem agreed to jointly pursue selected fixed offshore wind engineering, procurement and installation opportunities.

events.title: ABS classes WindFloat Atlantic
events.summary: Principle Power announced that the American Bureau of Shipping classed the WindFloat Atlantic floating offshore wind development. Ocean Winds and Principle Power are members of the project consortium.

events.title: Ramboll and COWI awarded Danish offshore geological modelling work
events.summary: Energinet awarded Ramboll and COWI an integrated geological modelling scope for offshore wind areas linked to Denmark’s proposed energy islands.

events.title: DNV starts offshore wind ground investigation project
events.summary: DNV launched a joint industry project to improve offshore ground investigation for wind turbines, including floating offshore wind. Acteon and COWI separately confirmed participation.

events.title: Jan De Nul reports completion of Formosa 2 foundations and cable work
events.summary: Jan De Nul reported completion of its Formosa 2 foundation and cable installation scope. The project account identifies Saipem as one of its jacket suppliers.

events.title: Wood Thilsted documents Vineyard Wind foundation scour assessment
events.summary: A technical appendix in the Vineyard Wind construction and operations plan records Wood Thilsted Partners’ foundation scour assessment and technical support for the cable route.

events.title: Wood Thilsted opens US offshore wind office
events.summary: Wood Thilsted announced a US office to support its offshore wind engineering work and respond to the growing US market.

events.title: Lloyd’s Register wins Hywind Tampen control-room engineering scope
events.summary: Lloyd's Register won human-machine interface engineering work for Equinor’s Hywind Tampen, including integration with an existing onshore control room.

events.title: Freja Offshore applies for Mareld floating wind permit
events.summary: Mainstream Renewable Power announced that its Freja Offshore joint venture submitted a permit application for the proposed Mareld floating wind development in Swedish waters.

events.title: Freja Offshore applies for Cirrus offshore wind permit
events.summary: Mainstream Renewable Power announced an offshore wind permit application by its Freja Offshore joint venture for Cirrus in the southern Baltic Sea.

events.title: Freja Offshore applies for Dyning floating wind permit
events.summary: Mainstream Renewable Power reported its Freja Offshore joint venture’s application for the proposed 2.5 GW Dyning floating wind development in the Baltic Sea.

events.title: Final turbine installed at Merkur offshore wind farm
events.summary: Industry coverage reported that the final GE Renewable Energy turbine was installed at Merkur. DEME Concessions was a member of the project’s developer and owner consortium.

events.summary: Saipem installed the Dogger Bank B platform using Saipem 7000. The developer identifies Hitachi Energy’s HVDC technology on the platform.

events.title: Boskalis announces Windpiper rock installation vessel
events.summary: Boskalis announced the Windpiper vessel conversion and identified offshore wind foundation protection among its intended first applications.

events.title: Jan De Nul takes delivery of the Voltaire installation vessel
events.summary: Jan De Nul took delivery of Voltaire, a heavy lift jack-up built for installation of large offshore wind turbines.

events.title: Corio announces plan to reorganise offshore wind development
events.summary: A Corio Generation spokesperson confirmed plans to reorganise its offshore wind business around a smaller project portfolio.

events.title: Corio applies for development consent for Sceirde Rocks
events.summary: Corio Generation’s project company submitted its 450 MW Sceirde Rocks offshore wind consent application to Ireland’s planning authority.

events.title: Corio’s Sceirde Rocks project company withdraws consent application
events.summary: Fuinneamh Sceirde Teoranta, owned by Corio Generation, withdrew the planning application for the Sceirde Rocks offshore wind project.

events.title: Corio reaches Dadaepo fisheries cooperation agreement
events.summary: Corio Generation signed a cooperation agreement with local fisheries representatives for its planned Dadaepo offshore wind development.

events.title: DNV completes first phase of floating substation design project
events.summary: DNV completed the first phase of an industry project assessing design requirements for substations serving floating offshore wind.

events.title: DNV launches floating wind mooring and dynamic cable project
events.summary: DNV launched a joint industry project on design and reliability requirements for floating wind moorings and dynamic inter-array cables.

events.title: Atlantic Shores selects COWI for transmission concept design
events.summary: COWI received a contract for conceptual design of the offshore wind project’s transmission infrastructure.

events.title: COWI wins Lillebælt nearshore wind engineering scope
events.summary: COWI was selected for technical construction and foundation consultancy on the Lillebælt nearshore wind project.
